patent_grounding.rationale: The revised holder, bearing, and lubricant-path details are supported by retrieved patent text. interfaces.rationale: BEARING.outer_support now mates to BEARING_HOLDER.bearing_support with compatible mechanical_structural type. Lubricant ports are connected in directionally consistent pairs; no unused duplicate holder inlet/outlet path remains.

textbook_application.rationale: The external lubricant boundary avoids inventing unspecified equipment. Modeling guidance is not used as invention evidence.

summary: Reviewed revision 5 against retrieved patent evidence and prior findings.
